name: fetch_three_state_values
description: Makes several calls through the routine table to fetch values, storing each returned value into the game state block at fixed offsets; a stored value at the third offset is fetched again when a flag word is nonzero. The first fetch's argument is a state field minus 112.

name: fetch_three_state_values
description: Same call sequence as the preceding routine: fetches values from the routine table, stores them at fixed state offsets, and refetches the third value when a flag word is nonzero.

name: initialise_hook_slot_state
description: Reads a per-slot flag from the game table; when clear it zeroes the hook value, otherwise it fetches a value into the hook field, clears a companion field, and adds one more fetched value into the accumulator when the slot index is below 3 and the hook value is nonzero.

name: fetch_hook_value_conditionally
description: Fetches a value into the hook field and clears a companion field; when the slot index argument is below 3 and the hook value is nonzero, it adds a further fetched value into the accumulator.

name: accumulate_fetched_value
description: Makes two calls through the routine table and adds the second returned value into the accumulator field of the game state.

name: update_mouse_pointer_position
description: Reads the mouse counter register (JOY0DAT) and converts the change since the last sample into horizontal and vertical deltas, wrapping at 255 and clamping the pointer to 0-313 horizontally and 0-193 vertically. It stores the new position and the last counter values, then decrements a timer field.

name: draw_hole_marker
description: Converts the hole's coordinates, then issues a short sequence of drawing calls whose vertical offsets depend on a stored angle-like value, and records the resulting screen position in the state block.

name: draw_filled_island_polygon
description: Selects a fill pen from the terrain type byte, then for each vertex in the terrain polygon fetches coordinates from the table, applies a scroll offset and a vertical offset of 32, and draws the outline with area move, draw and end calls.

name: draw_mud_quad_strips
description: Draws mud patches as sets of four-vertex quads: for each segment it fetches corner coordinates from the terrain table, offsets them by the scroll position and a 32-pixel vertical offset, and fills each quad with area move, draw and end calls.

name: draw_tee_box_markers
description: When the tee-enable flag is clear, chooses a pen from the terrain type byte, then draws two outlined boxes and four single-pixel marks at fixed screen positions around the tee.

name: build_view_transform_matrix
description: When the hole and angle fields are zero and the tee flag is clear it uses full-circle defaults; otherwise it fetches two values and scans a 128-entry angle table for the closest entry. It then writes the scaled and negated derived values and constants into the view-state block.

name: draw_info_panel_with_labels
description: Fills the right-hand info rectangle, then writes the club, power and wind labels and their right-justified decimal values, and a stored text field selected by a flag. Four state entries choose the pen for each hole slot.

name: write_text_string_at
description: Writes a string one character at a time using the length returned by a library call, advancing the horizontal position by seven pixels per character.

name: draw_abort_load_save_prompt
description: Draws the abort prompt box with its ABORT label, then highlights the LOAD or SAVE option when a state byte selects one, and draws a fixed row of characters beneath it.

name: open_screen_and_window
description: Opens the graphics and intuition library resources, then creates the screen, window and bitmap structures, copying a 10-entry configuration block and running memory setup. Any failed step calls the cleanup routine and records which resources were allocated.

name: allocate_chip_memory_block
description: Allocates a fixed-size block of chip memory, retrying smaller sizes when a free-memory query reports enough room. If the allocation still fails it draws a memory message and waits for the button to be released, then records five pointers into the block.

name: load_palette_from_parameter
description: Loads a 32-byte colour table, passed as the argument, into the stored screen's viewport through a graphics library call.

name: release_allocated_display_resources
description: Checks a bitmask of allocated resources and releases each marked one: stops the interrupt handler, frees the memory block, closes the window, screen and libraries, then calls the exit routine with zero.

name: set_mouse_pointer_image
description: Installs the pointer shape from the state block on the window, using a two-row image sixteen pixels wide with a zero hotspot.

name: select_next_hole_number
description: Finds the first hole whose flag is clear, then runs a menu loop that draws the hole number with an OK, Abort Game or Next Hole control, redrawing the highlighted choice until one is picked, and then shows the top view.

name: show_leader_board_screen
description: Clears the round state, rebuilds the view matrix and green, then draws the leader board frame: split screen areas, a ten-row grid, header columns and labels, and finally the score rows.

name: draw_score_table_grid
description: Draws the score table grid: three horizontal rules and nine vertical rules spaced 23 pixels apart, placed relative to the row offset passed in.

name: draw_player_score_row
description: Draws one player's leader board row: the name, the signed score or a placeholder, the total, and eighteen per-hole values, each coloured by comparing it with the stored best score, while accumulating front and back nine totals.

name: update_and_save_high_scores
description: Builds the high-score file path, locks and reads the scores file, and inserts the player's result into the sorted list of best entries when it qualifies. It writes the list back and reports a disk error if the write fails.

name: store_high_score_buffer_pointer
description: Copies a pointer from the loaded program header into the high-score buffer field of the state block.

name: write_scorecard_file
description: Opens the scorecard file, writes the title and header lines, then writes one block per player: a name line, per-hole scores formatted as text, and the front and back nine totals, before closing the file.

name: write_pattern_line
description: Passes a line-building routine to the output helper, which writes one fixed-pattern separator line of the scorecard.

name: fill_line_buffer_with_constant
description: Stores the same four-byte value into many consecutive stack words, producing a fixed-length block that the line writer then outputs.

name: write_string_to_file
description: Measures the given string with a library call and writes that many bytes of it to the open file.

name: format_score_three_chars
description: Formats a score into a three-character field: values below 101 get a leading space, larger values get hundreds, tens and units digits, and negative values are passed to the negative-score formatter.

name: format_negative_score_chars
description: Formats a negative score into the output field: below minus nine it writes a minus sign and two digits, otherwise a space, a minus sign and one digit.

name: read_mouse_button_state
description: Reads the button word set by the interrupt handler and updates two flags: one is cleared when both fire bits are pressed, and the other is cleared and the button word reset when the right and middle combination is seen.

name: animate_putt_sequence
description: Animates a putt over several frames: it draws the cup edge line, steps the ball along its path while plotting it, and calls the splash routine and terrain conversions as the ball moves.

name: draw_text_drop_shadow
description: Clears the area, then for each character in the string draws its glyph several times at offset positions in two colours to produce a drop shadow, advancing eight pixels per character.

name: draw_text_drop_shadow
description: Loop body of the same drop-shadow text routine: it draws each character glyph at offset positions across the string, advancing eight pixels per character.

name: initialise_font_settings
description: Sets the font size and offset fields, allocates a 1440-byte buffer, loads the font into it, and fills the colour slots and three state entries with default values.

name: fill_default_colour_slots
description: Stores the same default value into five consecutive colour slots, then sets three further state fields to that default.

name: read_font_file_into_buffer
description: Opens the font data file and, when the open succeeds, reads 1440 bytes of it into the font buffer and closes the file.

name: set_font_colours_from_mask
description: Clears the area, then for each of five bits in the argument sets the matching colour slot to the highlight value when the bit is set, or to the default value when it is clear.

name: set_font_colours_from_mask
description: Loop body of the colour-mask routine: it walks the bits of the mask and assigns each of the five colour slots either the default or the highlight value.

name: write_decimal_number_at
description: Converts the number to decimal text, moves to the given position and draws the digits with the text routine.

name: write_decimal_right_justified
description: Converts a number to decimal text, pads it on the left with spaces to the field width, then draws it at the given position.

name: write_signed_decimal_right_justified
description: Converts a signed number to decimal text, adds a plus sign when it is positive, pads it on the left with spaces to the field width, then draws it at the given position.

name: write_text_at_position
description: Moves the drawing position to the given coordinates, measures the string length with a library call and draws the string.

name: convert_integer_to_decimal_string
description: Converts an integer to decimal text by repeated division by ten, adds a minus sign for negative values, reverses the digits and terminates the string.

name: reverse_string_in_place
description: Reverses the bytes of a string in place, using a library call to find its length.

name: compute_integer_square_root
description: Computes the integer square root by adding consecutive odd numbers until the running sum reaches the argument, returning how many odd numbers were added.

name: wait_for_timer_ticks
description: Calls a library timer wait once for each step of the argument, pausing for the requested number of ticks.

name: set_foreground_pen
description: Sets the foreground drawing pen on the stored rastport to the pen number given.

name: set_background_pen
description: Sets the background drawing pen on the stored rastport to the pen number given.

name: fill_rectangle_with_current_pen
description: Fills the rectangle given by four coordinates on the stored rastport using the current pen.

name: write_decimal_on_screen
description: Writes a decimal number at the given position on the stored rastport by passing the rastport pointer to the decimal writer.

name: write_text_on_screen
description: Writes a text string at the given position on the stored rastport by passing the rastport pointer to the text writer.

name: move_draw_position
description: Moves the drawing position of the stored rastport to the given coordinates without drawing anything.

name: draw_line_to_point
description: Draws a line from the current drawing position on the stored rastport to the given coordinates.

name: plot_single_pixel
description: Plots one pixel at the given coordinates on the stored rastport.

name: draw_line_between_points
description: Moves to the first point and draws a line to the second point on the stored rastport.

name: wait_for_window_message
description: Polls the window's message port until a message arrives, sleeping on the port's signal bit between polls, and returns the message found.

name: initialise_tree_buffers
description: Sets the tree size and offset fields and the tree-status byte, then allocates several memory buffers for tree images and stores their pointers in the state block.

name: set_up_tree_images
description: When the requested tree set differs from the current one, switches the saved pointers, builds the tree images with the copy and shrink routines, and rebuilds tree positions when the tree flag is set.

name: place_tree_entries_in_table
description: Loops across the tree rows, copying each tree's block and recording its position and type in the tree tables; when the remaining count runs out it hands control to the tree setup routine.

name: show_selected_tree_image
description: Looks up the size and offsets for the selected tree type, builds four scaled offset steps, adjusts the stored tree count at its limit, then draws the tree through the blit and shrink routines.

name: shrink_tree_bitmap_rows
description: Copies a tree bitmap into the target one column strip at a time, shifting each strip by the bit alignment of the current position, and blits the pieces with the shared mask.

name: add_tree_to_draw_list
description: Records a tree's position, size and row values in the next tree slot, shifting its horizontal position by half its width, and blits the tree image when the entry lies within the screen.

name: check_ball_tree_collision
description: Walks the tree list and tests the ball's position against each tree's bounding box, setting the in-tree flag and returning a collision code when the ball overlaps a tree on the current row.

name: scan_collision_bitmap_rows
description: Packs collision bits from a rotating mask into a byte, reads the next row of pixels from the collision bitmap and checks it against the tree flag and the ball's row to set the collision result.

name: scan_collision_bitmap_columns
description: Steps across a row of collision pixels, accumulating mask bits into a byte, and reads new row data through the bitmap routine when the row count is passed, testing each result against the ball's column.

name: find_tree_index_for_ball
description: Walks the tree list while a flag is set and returns the index of the tree matching the ball's row, or the last index visited when the list ends.

name: advance_tree_list_index
description: Advances the tree list index when a collision flag is set, then walks the tree list while the ball remains in range, returning the index reached.

name: scan_tree_list_for_hit
description: Walks the tree list and tests the ball's column and row against each tree, recording a hit result and returning the index when the list ends.

name: test_ball_against_tree_entries
description: Tests the ball's column and row against a tree entry's bounds, clearing the in-tree flag or setting the result index when the ball is in range, then continues along the tree list.

name: reset_tree_scan_and_collide
description: Clears the in-tree flag, then walks the tree list reading each in-range tree's position and size, and hands the result to the tree collision routine.

name: stub_return_only
description: A routine consisting only of a return, with no work, calls or memory access.

name: update_ball_flight_step
description: Resets the ball state fields, then steps the ball along its path each frame, plotting its position and checking for collisions with the terrain and trees.

name: draw_power_meter_tick
description: While the meter is active, advances a vertical position and draws a short horizontal tick at that row, with a special bar at one fixed row; when the meter reaches its end it clears the active flags.

name: animate_power_meter_bar
description: Advances the meter bar one row per pass, erasing the previous row's tick and drawing the new one at fixed horizontal positions, and decrements the remaining-step counter.

name: start_ball_shot_when_ready
description: When a shot is armed and not yet started, checks a region result, possibly marks the club state, then initialises the ball and clears its in-flight state values.

name: advance_shot_meter_tick
description: Steps a meter tick across its row range, drawing each step as a short line; when the range is exhausted it clears the counters and calls the next shot-state routines.

name: run_ball_flight_loop
description: Checks the shot counter and re-initialises the ball when needed, then repeatedly plots the ball and hook state while the shot is in flight, until the in-flight flags clear.

name: run_ball_flight_frames
description: Re-initialises the ball when flagged, then repeatedly plots the ball and hook state while the shot is in flight, looping through the in-flight checks until they clear.

name: draw_meter_row_and_step
description: Draws one row of the meter at its current position, increments the step counter, and loops through the in-flight checks.

name: draw_meter_row_then_check
description: Draws a meter tick at the current row, increments the step counter, and runs the in-flight checks, calling the hook routine when the table entry is clear.

name: advance_shot_phase_timer
description: Counts down a phase timer, and when it reaches zero advances the shot phase index, sets the phase flag, reloads the timer from a per-phase table and chooses a horizontal position for the phase.

name: dispatch_shot_state_changes
description: Sets up a shot-state variable and, while the shot is active, dispatches on the current state: in state two it fetches a value clamped to zero through three, then runs the matching state handler.

name: dispatch_shot_state_with_setup
description: Sets up the shot-state variables and calls a setup routine on a state block, then runs the same shot-state dispatch loop as its neighbours.

name: reset_shot_state_and_dispatch
description: Clears the shot-state field, then runs the shot-state dispatch loop.

name: check_water_hit_and_splash
description: Tests whether the ball is in the hit region at its position; when it is, sets a flag, plays the splash sound routine and shows the splash image, then continues the shot-state dispatch loop.

name: play_splash_and_continue_shot
description: When its splash flag is set, plays the splash sound routine and shows the splash image, then continues the shot-state dispatch loop.

name: show_splash_stage_two
description: When the splash flag is set, shows the second splash image, then continues the shot-state dispatch loop.

name: show_third_splash_and_erase
description: When the splash flag is set, shows the third splash image and erases the splash, then continues the shot-state dispatch loop.

name: accumulate_ball_motion_values
description: While the shot state is idle, adds the stored velocity values into the position fields, fetches a new value to update the velocity, and repeats until the state changes.

name: dispatch_shot_state_code
description: Dispatches on a shot-state code: codes nine and eleven set the phase variables, with eleven also calling a setup routine; code sixteen clears the shot state, code seventeen fetches a value, and other codes pass on to the ball update.

name: handle_splash_shot_state
description: Handles shot states two and four: in state two it fetches a value clamped to zero through three, runs the splash routine and, when the second flag is clear, calls a setup routine; in state four it runs the matching setup.

name: update_shot_landing_position
description: Draws a marker at the current aim position when it is on the course, then stores the sum and difference of two fetched values as the shot's position fields.

name: run_splash_with_clamped_state
description: Fetches a value clamped to zero through three into the state, runs the splash routine, and when the second flag is clear calls the setup routine.

name: clamp_state_and_run_splash
description: Clamps the state value to at most three, runs the splash routine, and calls the setup routine when the second flag is clear.

name: call_setup_if_flag_clear
description: Calls the setup routine on the state block when the second flag is clear, then calls a further routine on the state block.

name: record_hole_position_and_wait
description: Runs a setup routine and a shot-state step, calls the setup routine when the second flag is clear, stores the current position values in the hole's record and waits for a fixed number of ticks.

name: handle_splash_or_setup_state
description: Handles shot state two by clamping the value, running the splash routine and calling setup when the second flag is clear; shot state four calls the setup routine and then another routine.

name: stub_return_only
description: A routine consisting only of a return, with no work, calls or memory access.

name: play_splash_animation
description: When the shot's stage index is above nine, plays the splash sound and shows the four splash frames in turn with pauses between them, then erases the splash and waits briefly.

name: check_ball_terrain_collision
description: When the ball is inside the course bounds, looks up the terrain type at its position and, for listed terrain types, sets the collision flag and returns the contact result.

name: mark_ball_stopped
description: Sets the ball-stopped flag and returns zero.

name: handle_tree_collision_bounce
description: Runs the tree collision test and, on a hit, either fetches an offset and sets the bounce velocity fields or, for a hit code of five or more, negates and halves the velocity fields.

name: reverse_ball_velocity_once
description: When the second flag is clear, negates the horizontal velocity, halves the vertical velocities, fetches a timer offset and sets the second flag.

name: check_terrain_then_tree_bounce
description: When the terrain code is one of the listed types, sets the ball-stopped flag; otherwise it runs the tree collision test and applies the bounce velocities when a tree is hit.

name: stub_return_zero
description: A routine that only returns zero, with no work, calls or memory access.

name: classify_ball_terrain_result
description: Returns three when the ball is off the course, five when it reaches the hole cup, and otherwise a code from the terrain type at its position; codes two and twenty-six give two, while codes three and six set the hazard flag and call a routine with argument seven.

name: classify_terrain_with_hole_check
description: Returns five at the hole cup, otherwise maps the terrain type at the ball's position to a result code, setting the hazard flag and calling a routine with argument seven for codes three and six.

name: classify_terrain_and_scan_ahead
description: Returns a result code from the terrain type at the ball's position; for type five it scans forward along the row until another type is found, returning four when that type is two or twenty-six.

name: set_hazard_flag_return_one
description: Sets the hazard flag, calls a routine with argument seven and returns one.

name: load_initial_ball_motion_fields
description: Fetches three values into the motion fields and, when the flag is set, replaces two of them with two more fetched values, then checks the results are within the limit.

name: classify_terrain_for_ball_motion
description: Maps a terrain code to a result: codes two and twenty-six return two, codes three and six set the hazard flag and return one, code five scans ahead along the row, and other codes fall through to the common path.

name: load_ball_motion_fields_checked
description: Fetches three values into the motion fields and, when the flag is set, replaces two of them with two more fetched values, then checks the results against the upper limit before accepting them.

name: stub_return_zero
description: A routine that only returns zero, with no work, calls or memory access.

name: copy_longwords_to_buffer
description: Copies the given byte count of longwords from the source to the destination, four bytes per step.

name: clear_bitmap_longword_buffer
description: Zeroes 800 consecutive longwords starting at the buffer address stored in the state block.

name: suggest_club_for_shot
description: Marks the club suggestion as active, clears the club panel when it is not hidden, looks up a distance band from a table, then picks a suggested club from the band and the lie code.

name: draw_club_selection_panel
description: Adjusts the club index for the current lie, then draws the club selection panel as stacked rectangles with the club labels.

name: draw_club_selection_rows
description: Adjusts the club index for the lie passed in registers, draws the club panel rectangles, and draws the selected row when the club suggestion is enabled.

name: draw_club_selection_frame
description: Adjusts the club index from the lie code, draws the club panel rectangles, and draws the club labels when the panel flags allow it.

name: draw_centred_menu_item
description: Draws a menu item string centred horizontally at a fixed row using its character count, and when the menu flag allows, records the item index and draws the selection highlight below it.

name: draw_menu_item_highlight
description: Draws a menu string at the given offset, and when the highlight flags are set, records the item index, draws the highlight rectangle and the item's entry text.

name: erase_club_suggestion_panel
description: Clears the club suggestion flag and erases the club panel rectangle from the screen.

name: initialise_golfer_and_splash_data
description: Sets the golfer sprite size and offset fields, computes five frame pointers, reserves a 40000-byte block, loads the golfer and splash data files into it and sets the frame positions.

name: activate_golfer_sprite_frames
description: Selects the golfer's sprite from a table using the hole index, draws its background block, and sets the size and frame offsets used for the golfer's animation.

name: erase_golfer_from_screen
description: Restores the golfer's rectangle from the background buffer to the screen, using the stored position and size.

name: draw_golfer_animation_frame
description: When the golfer's animation state has changed, looks up the new frame and its size from tables, clears the frame buffer and draws the golfer frame, offsetting it when the flag is set.

name: blit_golfer_frame_within_bounds
description: Moves the golfer's vertical draw position up until it fits under a limit of seventy-seven rows, then blits the frame with its offsets and masks.

name: blit_golfer_frame_with_mask
description: Blits the golfer frame at the given position with its mask, copies the background block beneath it, and blits the frame again from the second buffer.

name: start_splash_at_ball
description: Places the splash three pixels left and fifteen pixels up from the ball position, sets its timer from the argument, and draws the splash rectangle.

name: erase_splash_rectangle
description: Restores the splash rectangle from the background buffer, using the stored splash position.

name: draw_splash_frame
description: Erases the previous splash, looks up the splash frame for the stage and offset, then draws its bit pattern pixel by pixel in the splash colour.

name: activate_ball_at_start
description: Places the ball at its start position, sets its in-flight flag and clears its state byte, then draws the ball and its shadow with the blit routine and sets the pen.

name: erase_ball_from_screen
description: Restores the ball rectangle from the background buffer at its position, and also the shadow rectangle when the shadow position differs from the ball.

name: plot_ball_trajectory_step
description: Keeps the ball position within the course bounds, then draws the ball at its current position, plotting individual pixels and calling the offset clamp routine on the offsets.

name: clamp_value_to_ten
description: Clamps the value at the given address to the range minus ten to ten.

name: convert_ball_position_to_pixels
description: Converts the ball's fixed-point motion values to integer screen coordinates with rounding, adds the course offset and a vertical offset of 32, and saves the previous height value.

name: load_sound_data_file
description: Allocates a 65236-byte block, opens the sounds data file, reads its two sections into the block, and closes the file.

name: play_digitised_sound_sample
description: Clears the padding words before and after a sound sample in the sound buffer and sets up the sample's channel record from its header fields.

name: prepare_sound_channel_padding
description: Records whether the sample is shorter than four units, then clears the padding words of the sample buffer before and after the sample.

name: clear_sound_sample_padding
description: Clears the padding words around a sound sample in the sound buffer, then writes the sample's start position to the channel.

name: clear_sound_buffer_and_delay
description: Clears the padding words before the sample, clears the words after it, and waits through a short fixed delay loop.

name: start_audio_channel_dma
description: Clears the sample padding, waits through a short delay, then writes the sample address, length, period and volume to an audio channel's registers and sets the DMA enable bit.

name: start_sound_channel_playback
description: Waits through a short delay, programs an audio channel's address, length, period and volume, sets its DMA enable bit and, when the padding flag is set, updates the channel's interrupt request bit.

name: start_sound_channel_dma_loop
description: Waits through a delay, programs an audio channel's address, length, period and volume, enables its DMA bit with the set bit, then runs a second delay loop.

name: mark_sound_channel_active
description: After a delay, marks the audio channel as enabled and records the sample's state in the channel table, updating the second channel when the padding flag is set.

name: enable_sound_channel_dma_bit
description: When the channel's low bit is clear, writes the DMA enable bit for that channel and returns.

name: turn_sound_channels_off
description: Writes the value fifteen to the DMA control register so that all four audio channels are disabled.

name: fade_palette_to_black
description: Copies a 32-entry palette into a working buffer, then steps each entry's four-bit red, green and blue components toward zero over sixteen passes.

name: fade_palette_up_to_target
description: Clears a 32-entry working palette, then steps each entry's colour components toward the target palette over sixteen passes.

name: run_load_game_dialog
description: Refreshes the screen, shows the load dialog through a library call, waits for the button to be released, then loops reading input and returns when the pointer is inside a fixed vertical band.

name: poll_load_dialog_selection
description: Loops reading input while the pointer is inside the band, cycling a selection value between two items and wrapping it at nine, until the button is pressed.

name: toggle_selection_box_and_wait
description: Toggles the selection box with the exclusive-or helper, redraws the screen, waits for the button, then stores the current index and runs a timed pause before returning.

name: cycle_selection_box_up
description: Advances the selection index, wrapping from nine back to zero, then toggles the selection box, redraws the screen and waits for the button.

name: advance_selection_box_index
description: Advances the selection index by one, toggles the selection box, redraws the screen and waits for the button.

name: confirm_selection_and_return
description: Clears the button flag, waits for a press inside the band, then runs a timed pause, stores the index and returns whether the selection is not three.

name: store_selection_and_return_flag
description: Runs a timed pause, stores the index in the selection slot, and returns whether the selection is not three.

name: stub_return_one
description: A routine that only returns one, with no work, calls or memory access.

name: redraw_load_screen_buffer
description: Points the display at the back buffer, prints the load screen and displays the game, swaps the active buffer flag, then copies every second row to the screen in alternating order.

name: copy_screen_row
description: Waits for the display frame, then blits one 320-pixel-wide row at the given height from the back buffer to the front buffer.

name: draw_load_screen_segment
description: Moves to the first point and draws a line to the second point on the load-screen rastport.

name: move_load_screen_position
description: Moves the drawing position on the load-screen rastport to the given coordinates without drawing.

name: draw_load_screen_line_to
description: Draws from the current position on the load-screen rastport to the given point.

name: save_game_state_to_file
description: Copies the per-hole state blocks into the save buffer, element by element, then writes the saved game file.

name: load_saved_game_summary
description: Builds the saved-game file name from the slot digit, reads its 332-byte header into the buffer and closes it, then draws the game summary text and slot details.

name: stub_return_only
description: A routine consisting only of a return, with no work, calls or memory access.

name: draw_saved_game_parameters
description: Draws the saved game heading and its round number as text, then draws the stored course entries from the buffer.

name: draw_saved_game_entry_lines
description: Draws the slot number and the stored entry count as text, then draws each saved entry as a line of text at its stored position.

name: draw_saved_game_score_rows
description: Draws each saved entry's name at its row, then formats its total score from the stored values and draws it alongside.

name: draw_saved_player_names
description: Draws the player name label chosen by a flag for each stored entry, then draws the entry count digit and returns.

name: draw_saved_entry_names
description: Draws the stored entry name text for each entry in turn, then draws the final count digit and returns.

name: draw_load_screen_frame
description: Clears the load screen, draws its border and horizontal rules, and writes the column headings for name, course, level, holes in play, strokes and number of players.

name: draw_load_screen_buttons
description: Draws the four button labels across the bottom of the load screen: Exit, Save, View Last and View Next.

name: restore_game_state_from_save
description: Copies the saved per-hole state blocks back from the save buffer, then runs the course setup and returns whether it succeeded.

name: apply_loaded_game_parameters
description: Sets the hole count, player count and current-hole index from the loaded header, copies twenty bytes of course data, and returns whether the load routine succeeds.

name: stub_return_zero
description: A routine that only returns zero, with no work, calls or memory access.

name: toggle_selection_box
description: Sets the drawing mode to exclusive-or, fills a rectangle at the selected slot's box offset, then restores normal drawing.

name: open_load_course_dialog
description: Sets up the course input, initialises the dialog's default fields, then opens the load-course dialog box.

name: handle_load_dialog_messages
description: Loops waiting for dialog messages, replying to each; when a gadget message arrives it selects the file for the chosen drive and tries to open that drive's directory.

name: select_file_and_open_directory
description: Selects the file slot for the drive index passed in, then opens that drive's directory.

name: stub_return_only
description: A routine consisting only of a return, with no work, calls or memory access.

name: draw_load_file_dialog
description: Draws the load dialog frame with its drawer and file panels, the drive labels df0 and df1 and the Cancel and Load buttons, then lists the directory contents and enters the message loop.

name: draw_three_d_button_box
description: Draws a raised three-dimensional box at the given position using a border rectangle and two inset bevel rectangles.

name: highlight_gadget_until_released
description: Inverts the gadget box, waits for its release message, replies to it, then inverts the box back.

name: reply_and_invert_gadget_box
description: Replies to the pending message and inverts the gadget box.

name: invert_gadget_box
description: Sets exclusive-or drawing mode and fills the gadget's rectangle, offset by a second gadget's position when one is given, then restores normal mode.

name: load_and_display_directory_listing
description: Locks the given directory; if the lock fails it draws the error box, otherwise it examines the directory and lists its entries in the directory panel.

name: copy_name_and_examine_entry
description: Copies a file name into the name buffer up to its terminator, records its length, then examines the directory entry and draws it.

name: list_directory_entries_into_panel
description: Clears the directory panel, copies the current path into its header, then steps through directory entries, adding each file name to the list and drawing it.

name: display_names_and_unlock_directory
description: Displays the collected file names, then releases the directory lock.

name: append_file_name_to_list
description: Copies a null-terminated name byte by byte into the file-name buffer at the next free position, reserving the space with a library call.

name: stub_return_only
description: A routine consisting only of a return, with no work, calls or memory access.

name: open_selected_directory_entry
description: If the selected entry is a directory, releases the current lock and steps back to the parent directory; otherwise it opens the chosen entry, building its path in a 90-byte buffer.

name: enter_or_leave_directory_path
description: For the directory marker it releases the lock, removes the last path level and reloads the parent listing; otherwise it appends the entry name to the path.

name: draw_empty_directory_message
description: When the entry count is zero, clears the panel and draws the path text in a message box; otherwise it returns without drawing.

name: build_path_and_reload_listing
description: Copies the current path into the path buffer, records the new path length, appends a separator when a parent level exists, and reloads the directory listing.

name: draw_current_path_panel
description: Clears the path panel, draws its border, copies the current path into the path buffer, and draws the path text.

name: build_path_then_open_directory
description: Copies the path into the path buffer, appends a separator when a parent level exists, builds the full path string character by character, and tail-calls the directory open routine.

name: display_directory_entries
description: Draws up to eight directory entries in the panel, showing each name with a directory marker where the entry is a directory, starting from the current position.
